rationale: Record test-only scheduling for Pulp's real-browser capture validation. The 27 existing integration cases move unchanged from three into six themed *.integration.test.mjs files, and run_integration.mjs sizes file concurrency at one Chrome per two cores and per 2 GiB of a declared memory lease, capped by the file count, instead of a fixed width of three above six cores. A 3-vCPU VM still runs one file at a time and a 6-vCPU VM still runs three; a 12-vCPU VM now runs six. RUN_SERIAL, every per-case and outer timeout, production browser capture, design ingest, captured output, rendering, packaging, the accepted expansion boundary, and Vellum source authority are unchanged.
